title: Deadly Isolation
description: Two escaped convicts go after a widow (Sherilyn Fenn) whose husband helped them steal a fortune in jewels.

title: Deadly Match
description: Trina goes live with her unique dating website, and it becomes a huge success until she shuts it down to stop a prostitution hub. When one of the users from the site turns up dead, Trina looks to her now-defunct site for clues to solve the crime.

title: Death She Wrote
description: A famous author hires a personal assistant to work out of her home, not realizing that the woman is actually a deranged fan who plans on taking over her entire life.

description: The purported self-help group NXIVM traps thousands and targets the minds and bodies of young women from around the country; actress Catherine Oxenberg shares her personal fight to get her daughter out of the outrageous cult.

title: You Can't Take My Daughter
description: Amy, a vibrant law student, is attacked and raped by Demetri, a friend of a friend she met once. Discovering that she is pregnant from the rape, Amy makes the difficult decision to keep the baby.

title: Little Girl in the Woods
description: While backpacking in the deep woods, members of a women's bereavement support group must band together to save a teenage girl who's being held captive in a cabin.

title: Little Girl in the Window
description: When amateur photographer Iris notices "help" scrawled on a dusty window in a picture she took of an old house, she becomes increasingly convinced that the man living there isn't as mild-mannered as he seems.

description: Celebrities and prominent individuals cheat the system and illicitly pay for their children's admission to the nation's most prestigious universities with the help of William "Rick" Singer, the mastermind behind the scam.
